approvers: My adviser or broker, my accountant, my wife and children, my bank
reason: A free confidential first meeting costs me nothing and the bank letter and named directors sound serious, so I will listen. But my broker runs the process and I take the highest cash offer; 10% held back for a year and no references makes me think others will pay more at closing.
objection: I expect a higher price; others will pay more in cash at closing, and 10% deferred for a year is money I do not have in my hand.
instead: Let my broker collect offers, list on nexxt-change, and sell to whoever pays the most cash, or keep running the business a few more years.
would_change_my_mind: 100% cash at closing at a price clearly above the other bids, with the bank letter checked by my adviser.
